description: Bring PlateLens—an AI-powered calorie and nutrition tracker—into ChatGPT. Ask about the data you already log: review calories, macros, micronutrients, and ingredients; understand your estimated calorie deficit or surplus against your plan; summarize hydration and activity; follow weight changes against your goals; and review recorded glucose readings with their measurement times and provenance when you grant the separate glucose permission. The integration is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete PlateLens data. Results reflect estimates and synced observations in your account, not diagnoses, treatment advice, or medication recommendations.
